user.title: Blink Camera Streamer
user.description: Point this at the stream the add-on is re-broadcasting. With the go2rtc bridge from the add-on documentation, that is an RTSP URL such as rtsp://homeassistant.local:8554/blink_bureau.

data_description.stream_url: rtsp:// from go2rtc, or tcp:// straight from the add-on.

error.invalid_url: Use a rtsp://, rtsps://, tcp://, http:// or https:// URL including a host.

abort.already_configured: That stream is already set up.
